lines.t: I have put forth a great multitude of words to bless you, a great number of loving and stern speeches. I have called this generation to repent, and have given ample warning. And those who cupped their ears heard My voice, and those who received of Me wrote My words in their heart, sincerely seeking to do them, that they might honor Me and bring glory to My name.
And there is but One Escape...
No matter the time or the season,
